 Mostly Cloudy with a few Drizzle Spots this Halloween 
 Rain is likely to begin next week. 
 By Derrick Overland Published : Oct. 31, 2026 at 12:21 PM CDT | Updated : 19 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ROCHESTER, Minn. (KTTC) – Happy Halloween! Today has been a very fall-like day, with mostly cloudy skies and a few spots of drizzle. Tonight, we will have cloudy skies with temperatures in the 50s. A few sprinkles/drizzle may be possible later in the evening. But for the most part, we should be dry.
 Trick-or-Treat Forecast (KTTC) Here is another reminder that it’s not just Halloween tonight. We also fall back an hour as daylight saving time ends and standard time begins. So remember to set those clocks an hour back before you go to bed tonight. Tonight will be our last sunset after 5 pm until January 18th! 
 DST Ends Tonight (KTTC) For Sunday, we will have cloudy skies in the morning, but later in the day we are expected to see some sunshine. Depending on how fast we can clear our skies will determine how warm we get. Right now, we will likely be in the mid to upper 60s, but if clouds linger most of the day, we’ll be a bit cooler.
 Tomorrow's Forecast (KTTC) Rain chances will return at the beginning of the week, mainly on Monday. Rain chances will continue through Wednesday. 
 Rain Chances Next 10 Days (KTTC) The next week will likely be fairly mild, with cooler temperatures toward the end of the week. Rain chances are likely at the beginning of the week.
 10-Day Forecast (KTTC) Happy Halloween & have a great rest of your weekend! -Derrick
